topics.title: Anchor 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas

outcomes.text: Compose and improvise rhythmic ideas or motives that reflect music from historical periods studied in rehearsal.

topics.title: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas

outcomes.text: Select and develop draft melodic and rhythmic ideas or motives showing understanding of music from historical periods studied.
Preserve draft compositions and improvisations through standard notation and audio recording.

topics.title: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work

outcomes.text: Evaluate and refine draft compositions and improvisations using knowledge, skill and teacher-provided criteria.
Share personally developed melodies and rhythmic passages, alone or as an ensemble, showing understanding of music studied in rehearsal.

topics.title: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work

outcomes.text: Select varied repertoire to study using interest, music-reading skill, structure of the music, context, and the technical skill of the performer or ensemble.
Demonstrate, using music-reading skills, how knowledge of formal characteristics of musical works informs prepared or improvised performances.
Identify expressive qualities in a varied repertoire that can be shown through prepared and improvised performance.

topics.title: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques and work

outcomes.text: Use self-reflection and peer feedback to refine individual and ensemble performances of a varied repertoire.

topics.title: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work

outcomes.text: Demonstrate attention to technical accuracy and expressive qualities in prepared and improvised performances of a varied repertoire.
Demonstrate awareness of the context of the music through prepared and improvised performances.

topics.title: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work

outcomes.text: Identify reasons for selecting music based on characteristics in the music and connections to interest, purpose or context.
Identify how knowledge of context and the use of repetition, similarities and contrasts inform the response to music.

topics.title: Anchor 8: Interpret intent and meaning in artistic work

outcomes.text: Identify interpretations of the expressive intent and meaning of musical works, citing how elements of music, contexts and text setting are treated.

topics.title: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work

outcomes.text: Identify and describe how interest, experience, analysis and context affect the evaluation of music.

topics.title: Anchor 10: Relate artistic ideas and works with societal, cultural, and historical context

outcomes.text: Show how interests, knowledge and skills relate to personal choices and intent when creating, performing and responding to music.

topics.title: Anchor 11: Synthesize and relate knowledge and personal experiences to make art

subtopics.title: Connections to other arts and disciplines

outcomes.text: Show understanding of relationships between music and the other arts, other disciplines, varied contexts and daily life.

Preserve draft musical works through standard notation, audio or video recording.

Show how understanding the style, genre and context of a varied repertoire informs performances and the performer's technical skill in connecting with the audience.

outcomes.text: Develop, apply and refine rehearsal strategies for expressive challenges, evaluating success with feedback from peers and other sources.
